text_markup: The Runner has a {card:Femme Fatale} installed and chose a {card:Tollbooth} with its "when installed" ability. When the Runner encounters the {card:Tollbooth}, they pay 1[c] to bypass the {card:Tollbooth} with {card:Femme Fatale}. Because the resolution of {card:Femme Fatale}'s ability causes the encounter to end, the pending ability from {card:Tollbooth} cannot be triggered. The Runner does not pay 3[c], and the run does not end.
